page_title: Deep-Image.ai - AI Image Enhancer to Generate & Upscale

sources.entry: 16. Deep Image - Enhance image resolution with AI.

summary.name: Deep-Image.ai
summary.one_liner: Deep-Image.ai is a web-based AI photo enhancer that upscales images, edits photos from text prompts, restores old photos, and generates product backgrounds and avatars.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI photo platform with several tools: Packshot Pro for bulk marketplace product photos using presets and custom sizes, and upscaling for print DPI requirements, including restoring compressed images from Google Photos. It can repair scratches, tears and faded colors in old photos and lets users compare presets. Users can edit photos with text prompts (backgrounds, lighting, color, watercolor style) and combine up to 3 photos. It also generates digital art and avatars from text prompts and image-to-image, and offers real estate enhancements such as white balance and HDR. The page mentions a custom business solutions service with partner Teonite and an API for integrations.
notable: Text-prompt photo editing, combining up to 3 photos
Packshot Pro bulk product photos with presets
Restores old photos: scratches, tears, faded colors
Public API and integrations with eCommerce sites
caveats: Meta description says try free with no credit card required, but paid tiers are not detailed on the page
Custom business solutions require contacting the company
